edits.why: line 8 is an ordinary full-width Chukchi text line (margin number 30 read into it), flush left, in the same run as lines 1-7 and 9-18; it is in no band only because of the unzoned flag, and belongs with the continuing text above.

notes.text: Unzoned/uncovered flag (y 1643-1737) is this one line; no separate printed line missed. Could equally be seen as bridging bands 2 and 3, since line 9 is also flush; no paragraph opens here.
